checks.check: Pre-author ecological primary study compares infant primary/secondary RSV activity with prior and pre-pandemic seasons and finds large reductions, greatest among younger infants. Authors infer preventive effect. No individual immunisation status, unadjusted influenza/household-immunity effects and missing hospital status limit causal attribution. Supports broad substantial preventive contribution; no exact causal fraction or exclusive programme explanation. Primary journal full text accessible; PMC challenge and PubMed incomplete rendering were disclosed.
